gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-numans: Numans spreads wide, its tracking loosened and its lowercase swollen like coiled rope, a plain sans with hanging s ends. Edo SZ does its best work with chunky, uniform diagonals; Numans does its best in the quiet.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-onest: Edo SZ stands up with lowercase letters as stately as cast iron capitals. Onest follows with short ascenders over big bowls and a gentle, monotone line, so a long passage would glide along without snagging.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-orienta: Orienta reads open and modern, its counters breathing like a cut reed and its cases close in height. And Edo SZ, one constant stroke throughout, would look thin and wiry if the heading were made small.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-oxygen: Stately and unwavering, Edo SZ draws every line at a width that never swells or tapers. Oxygen then takes over with curves that never close back on themselves, its lowercase nearly matching its capitals, so the page moves from monument to conversation.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-parkinsans: Parkinsans keeps one stroke thickness everywhere, crisp even when shrunk. Under Edo SZ, with its cast-iron lowercase, the text would move briskly, each wide-mouthed letter easy to pick out as the lines pile up.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-pathway-extreme: Pathway Extreme reads with clear openings in rounded letters and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height, a plain sans through and through. Edo SZ is the showpiece; Pathway Extreme does the talking.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-preahvihear: Edo SZ looks like glass tubing bent into letters, hollow and unbroken from start to finish. But Preahvihear counters with open mouths like pried oyster shells and a lofty x-height, giving the sans a grounded, easy footing beneath it.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-prompt: Approachable is the mood in Prompt, whose small letters look oversized and whose apertures stay open. And Edo SZ, with wire-bent s curves that never thin, could go large above it while Prompt stays modest.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-pt-sans-caption: PT Sans Caption has big-bodied lowercase and bowls that feel unclosed and inviting, a sans with a modern, workmanlike manner. Edo SZ earns its keep in large, brief lines, where its hollow glass-tube strokes show.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-puritan: Approachable and rounded, Puritan keeps its forms open to the side and gives its e and a oversized counters. Edo SZ lays fine rope-like strokes across the top, and the sans keeps everything underneath friendly.
